content:
Aisha: Ran a perf sweep this morning across Llama-2-13B (HF), Mixtral-8x7B, Qwen-7B on G4dn-like instance. Focus: kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV cache warm/cold behavior.
Jon: Nicely. What's the high-level takeaway?
Aisha: Short: for short contexts (<1024) fused_attention_v2 yields 15-25% throughput uplift on Llama and Mixtral. Qwen prefers matmul-tiling kernel at long seq (>2k) due to RoPE scaling overheads.
Ravi: Can you paste the profiling traces? saw some memory stalls earlier.
Aisha: Sure, pasted below from perf-prof.
perf-bot: benchmark run 1763459999 -- status: completed -- artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/1763459999/
Aisha: ```
# Llama-2-13B @ bs=4
kernel=fused_attention_v2 seq=512 throughput=48.2 tok/s latency_p95=38ms
kernel=matmul_tiled seq=2048 throughput=12.6 tok/s latency_p95=210ms
# Mixtral-8x7B @ bs=8
kernel=fused_attention_v2 seq=512 throughput=76.4 tok/s latency_p95=30ms
# Qwen-7B @ bs=8
kernel=matmul_tiled seq=2048 throughput=68.1 tok/s latency_p95=95ms
``` 
Aisha: Also saw KV-cache behavior: cold-start (first request after model load) incurs ~80ms penalty for big KV allocations on Llama-2-13B. Warm reuse with prefix caching removes that.
Eve: That's the RoPE scaling artifact? We saw head dimension mismatch earlier.
Aisha: Related: Llama head dim 128 vs Qwen 64 changed memory layout and kernel tiling efficiency. On Mixtral we saw suboptimal vectorization when head dim not divisible by 32.
Sam: What batching heuristics did you test?
Aisha: Two heuristics:
- size_based: cap tokens per batch to 4096
- latency_aware: prefer smaller batches for seq>1024 to keep p95 under 120ms
Aisha: Results: size_based gives better throughput for short seq workloads; latency_aware reduces tail latency for mixed workloads with long sequences.
Ravi: Any recommended default configs for Dedicated pools?
Aisha: Suggested config snippet attached.
Aisha: ```yaml
model: llama-2-13b
kernels:
  preferred: fused_attention_v2
  fallback: matmul_tiled
batching:
  heuristic: latency_aware
  max_tokens_per_batch: 4096
kv_cache:
  preallocate_threshold: 1024 # prealloc KV for contexts >=1k
  reuse_policy: prefix_cache
rope:
  scaling_policy: linear_clip
  clip_threshold: 2048
``` 
Jon: Nice. Any regressions flagged?
Aisha: One regression: a recent kernel optimization bumped Mixtral p95 for seq~600 by ~18% due to non-aligned loads; created issue #3201.
perf-bot: created issue perf/3201 (Mixtral kernel misalignment)
Eve: Action items?
Sam: 1) Add per-model kernel selection table to runtime config. 2) Test prealloc KV toggle on Dedicated for high-concurrency customers. 3) Patch Mixtral kernel alignment.
Aisha: I'll open PR with changes for Llama and Qwen defaults and link to the perf artifacts.
Jon: Thx. If someone can pair on reproducing Mixtral reg I'll help.
Ravi: I'll grab the artifacts and run against our TF-compatible runtime in the morning.
Eve: ping me once PR is ready; want to verify cascade tests.
Aisha: Thanks all :rocket:
